versions.subject: Merge PR #5640 from @swachchhanda000 - IIS WebServer Log Deletion via CommandLine Utilities
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\cmd.exe'
          - '\powershell_ise.exe'
          - '\powershell.exe'
          - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'cmd.exe'
          - 'powershell.exe'
          - 'powershell_ise.exe'
          - 'pwsh.dll'
selection_cli_del:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'del '
        - 'erase '
        - 'rm '
        - 'remove-item '
        - 'rmdir '
selection_cli_iis_dir:
    CommandLine|contains: '\inetpub\logs\'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell_ise.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "powershell_ise.exe", "pwsh.dll") CommandLine IN ("*del *", "*erase *", "*rm *", "*remove-item *", "*rmdir *") CommandLine="*\\inetpub\\logs\\*"
